highlights: When frost warnings for tonight and for a later night both arrive the same day, Today now shows both, tonight first; when a later email corrects which night the same cold snap falls on, Today shows only the corrected night
When a Frost watch email says a second forecast is colder for tonight, Today's watch line, forecast card and cue show that colder low, and so does the email's subject, for example: as low as 35°F
If a Frost protect tonight email went out and a later forecast puts tonight at 40°F or warmer, Today now says so, for example: Forecast warmed to 44°F since the 3 PM frost email
Frost emails about tonight now end: Pick what's ripe and cover tender plants tonight

21 plants, including the hosta, Japanese maple, nasturtiums, kales, beans and carrot, now get feed reminders at the interval the app's care data gives them instead of every 14 days: less often for 18 of them, weekly for the two petunias
A plant in a container you have deleted no longer gets care cards on Today

The variety editor now edits a variety's origin country and region, its breeding (F1, open-pollinated, landrace, unknown) with where that came from, and where its heat figure came from; choosing Open-pollinated on a variety not yet marked as a single named variety records it as one
